summary: Focused verification of this round's features — ALL PASS. (1) Google sign-in WEB flow: google-signin-button navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<app origin>/ (redirect param verified = app origin). Simulated return to <origin>/#session_id=fake-test-id-123: app calls POST /api/auth/session, receives 401, stays on welcome screen, no crash, no stuck spinner ('Continue to campcook' button interactive, 0 loading indicators). The only console errors during this flow were a 404 for auth.emergentagent.com's own background asset (third-party page, not our app) and the expected 401 from /api/auth/session. (2) Backend Google endpoints: new test file test_google_auth.py 5/5 — invalid session_id -> 401 'Invalid or expired Google sign-in session'; replay of same id -> 401 'This sign-in link was already used'; /auth/me without token -> 401; unknown token -> 401; /api/auth/google available:true; /api/config google_managed_ready:true; too-short session_id -> 422. (3) Kitchen sign-in link: visible on welcome screen, navigates to /caterer/login, CAT1001 login works, dashboard loads. (4) Sales export: export-csv-button fired a real browser download campcook-sales-2026-10-05.csv (43 lines; verified content includes summary lines Date/Total revenue/Orders/Completed + orders table with header and data rows), export-message 'CSV ready — check your downloads/share sheet.'; export-pdf-button on web shows guidance 'PDF export works in the mobile app — use CSV here, or open CampCook in Expo Go.' (5) Regression smoke: STU12345 login -> home menu (exactly 6 dishes) -> add Masala Chai -> cart (₹20) -> checkout -> Cash at counter (testID pay-cash) -> 'Order placed!' confirmation CC-8EEDA6DD -> sign out -> sign in -> orders list contains CC-8EEDA6DD plus prior CC-8C2F2D4A and CC-B2108DD4 (persistence holds). (6) No console/page errors on welcome mount from Google callback processing with no session_id. Full backend pytest 14/14 green. Bonus: iteration_3 leftover 'Test Lemon Rice' is now GONE from the menu (DB cleaned). No deprecated Expo packages found (no expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch).

minor.issue: Design note (matches spec, not a bug): the one-time guard burns the session_id BEFORE the Emergent exchange, so a session_id that fails exchange (invalid/expired) can never be retried. Also data['session_token'] is accessed unguarded — a 200 response missing session_token would 500. Both LOW priority hardening items.

action_items: LOW/optional: in /api/auth/session use data.get('session_token') with a 401 fallback instead of data['session_token'] to avoid a 500 on malformed Emergent responses.
LOW/optional: consider only burning session_id in db.used_session_ids after a successful exchange (currently burned before) — spec-compliant as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: google-auth.ts web flow correct: redirects to auth.emergentagent.com with origin redirect, extractSessionId parses ?/#/& forms, one-time 'exchanged' Set removes id on failure so a retry after reload works.

store.tsx processes Google callback (consumeWebCallback) before stored-session restore and validates stored sessions via /auth/me, clearing on 401 messages containing 'sign in' — both backend 401 messages ('Please sign in to continue', 'Session expired, please sign in again') match this check. Verified live: no errors on mount without session_id.

export.ts CSV builder escapes all fields, includes summary + orders table; web uses blob download, native uses expo-file-system/legacy + expo-sharing; PDF web path returns guidance string instead of attempting expo-print. Verified end-to-end with a real download event.
sales.tsx filters /caterer/orders by sales.date before export and handles the empty case ('No orders to export for today yet.').

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 pytest incl. 5 new Google auth tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass (Google web redirect + simulated 401 callback, kitchen link, caterer login/dashboard, CSV download + PDF guidance, customer smoke + re-login persistence, clean console on mount)
